spacesuit-mk2.name: Spacesuit MK2
spacesuit-mk2.description: +1 Defense. +1 Endurance. Allows movement along the ship's outer hull between airlocks.

gu4-rd.name: GU4-RD
gu4-rd.description: Before attacking, roll 1 die. On a success, deal 1 damage to the enemy.

medic-bag.name: Field Medic's Bag
medic-bag.description: Spend an action and credits to heal yourself or another player in your space or an adjacent space (1 credit = 1 health).

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.description: Allows you to carry 2 additional items.

pistol.name: Pistol
pistol.description: +2 combat strength. Reroll one die once per attack.

smuggler-mark.name: Smuggler's Mark
smuggler-mark.description: Get a 2-credit discount on any purchase. You may trade one item with any player anywhere on the map as an action.

circular-saw.name: Circular Saw
circular-saw.description: Up to 2 rerolls of one die per attack.

laser-cutter.name: Laser Cutter
laser-cutter.description: After you kill an enemy, deal 1 damage to all enemies in the same sector.

exo-gloves.name: Exo Gloves
exo-gloves.description: In combat, any pair of matching die results adds 1 hit.

pneumo-cannon.name: Pneumatic Cannon
pneumo-cannon.description: +1 combat strength. A roll of 3 counts as a hit; a 6 deals damage to both the enemy and the character.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.description: +3 combat strength. Enemies leave no loot.

knife.name: Knife
knife.description: +1 combat strength. If you score no hits during an attack, take 1 damage.

ultrasonic-hammer.name: Ultrasonic Hammer
ultrasonic-hammer.description: +4 combat strength. After defeating an enemy, spend 5 credits to recharge.

spacesuit.name: Spacesuit
spacesuit.description: +1 defense. Allows movement along the ship’s outer hull between airlocks.

last-chance.name: Last Chance
last-chance.description: +1 combat strength. If you score no hits during an attack, deal 1 damage to that enemy.

laser-scalpel.name: Laser Scalpel
laser-scalpel.description: +1 Science. In combat, use your Science instead of Strength.

pipe-wrench.name: Pipe Wrench
pipe-wrench.description: +1 combat strength. +1 Repair. You may reroll any number of dice during a Repair check.

shooter-helmet.name: Marksman’s Helmet
shooter-helmet.description: In combat, a die result of 3 counts as a hit.

implant-agility.name: Implant A
implant-agility.description: +1 Agility. Can be transferred, takes no backpack slot, cannot be removed after use; maximum of 2 implants in use.

implant-endurance.name: Implant B
implant-endurance.description: +1 Endurance. Can be transferred, takes no backpack slot, cannot be removed after use; maximum of 2 implants in use.

implant-repair.name: Implant R
implant-repair.description: +1 Repair. Can be transferred, takes no backpack slot, cannot be removed after use; maximum of 2 implants in use.

implant-science.name: Implant N
implant-science.description: +1 Science. Can be transferred, takes no backpack slot, cannot be removed after use; maximum of 2 implants in use.

implant-strength.name: Implant S
implant-strength.description: +1 Strength. Can be transferred, takes no backpack slot, cannot be removed after use; maximum of 2 implants in use.

ghb-dtn.name: GHB-DTN
ghb-dtn.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to move yourself or an ally up to 2 sectors.

r69-nic3.name: R69-NIC3
r69-nic3.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to ignore all non-boss enemy abilities until the end of the round.

gtu-b1c4.name: GTU-B1c4
gtu-b1c4.description: In combat, you may exhaust this robot to add 1 hit to an enemy.

c6-car-courier.name: C6-CAR “Courier”
c6-car-courier.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to trade any number of items with another player anywhere on the map.

sc0-u7.name: SC0-U7
sc0-u7.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to reveal any map tile.

prot2-ct.name: PROT2-CT
prot2-ct.description: In combat, you may exhaust this robot to gain +1 Defense until the end of the round.

alarm-bot.name: ALARM BOT
alarm-bot.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to ignore all non-boss enemy abilities until the end of the round.

sc13-nc3.name: SC13-NC3
sc13-nc3.description: During a Science or Repair check, you may exhaust this robot to reroll all dice.

f1t-b07.name: F1T-B07
f1t-b07.description: During an Endurance or Agility check, you may exhaust this robot to reroll all dice.

prot3-ct.name: PROT3-CT
prot3-ct.description: You may exhaust this robot to ignore any damage until the end of the round.

h3-al.name: H3-AL
h3-al.description: During your turn, you may exhaust this robot to restore 3 health to yourself or an ally.

brass-knuckles.name: Makeshift Knuckles
brass-knuckles.description: During an attack, you may take 2 damage to add 1 hit.

old-cloak.name: Old Cloak
old-cloak.description: +1 Defense. Healing effects restore 1 additional health.

assault-rifle.name: Assault Rifle
assault-rifle.description: +2 combat strength. Once per attack, reroll any number of dice.

shotgun.name: Shotgun
shotgun.description: +3 combat strength. After attacking, if a non-boss enemy survives, push it up to 2 open spaces in any direction.

drg-4u.name: DRG-4U
drg-4u.description: Carry 2 additional items. During a Strength check or attack, you may exhaust this robot to reroll all dice.

swiss-army-knife.name: Swiss Army Knife
swiss-army-knife.description: +1 Strength, Science, Repair, Endurance and Agility. It also has a corkscrew.

plague-doctor-mask.name: Plague Doctor Mask
plague-doctor-mask.description: +1 Defense. Completely prevents damage from boils.

nanobots.name: Nanobots
nanobots.description: Discard to restore 1 health and gain +1 Defense until the end of the round.

air-canister.name: Air Canister
air-canister.description: Discard this card and spend an action to move once between airlocks.

adrenaline-supply.name: Adrenaline
adrenaline-supply.description: During your turn, discard this card to gain 1 additional action.

defibrillator.name: Defibrillator
defibrillator.description: During your turn, discard this card to reroll any number of dice.

dry-rations.name: Dry Rations
dry-rations.description: During your turn, you may discard this card to restore 4 health.

tripwire.name: Tripwire
tripwire.description: Spend an action and place this in your sector to kill one non-boss enemy that appears there or enters it.

gas-cylinder.name: Gas Cylinder
gas-cylinder.description: Spend an action and discard this card to kill one non-boss enemy in your sector.

door-remote.name: Door Remote
door-remote.description: Spend 1 action and 2 credits to remotely open or close any corridor passage.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.description: You do not spend a step to reveal a map tile when entering it.

medkit.name: Medkit
medkit.description: During your turn, you may discard this card to restore all health.

proton-shield.name: Proton Shield
proton-shield.description: During your turn, discard this card to prevent all damage until the end of the round.

water.name: Water
water.description: During your turn, you may discard this card to restore 3 health.

ration.name: Ration
ration.description: During your turn, you may discard this card to restore 5 health.

adrenaline-x.name: Adrenaline-X
adrenaline-x.description: During your turn, discard this card to gain 2 additional actions.

power-cell.name: Power Cell
power-cell.description: During your turn, discard this card to ready one of your robots.

science-stimulant.name: Science Stimulant
science-stimulant.description: During a Science check, discard this card to reroll 1 die.

agility-stimulant.name: Agility Stimulant
agility-stimulant.description: During an Agility check, discard this card to reroll 1 die.

endurance-stimulant.name: Endurance Stimulant
endurance-stimulant.description: During an Endurance check, discard this card to reroll 1 die.

repair-stimulant.name: Repair Stimulant
repair-stimulant.description: During a Repair check, discard this card to reroll 1 die.

strength-stimulant.name: Strength Stimulant
strength-stimulant.description: During a Strength check, discard this card to reroll 1 die.

drekovac.name: Drekovac
drekovac.description: Slow but strong enemy. The player’s combat strength is reduced by 1.

vurdalak.name: Vurdalak
vurdalak.description: A resilient enemy: it restores all health if not killed during the turn.

plagued.name: Plagued
plagued.description: An enemy afflicted by boils: when it dies, it leaves 1 boil in each adjacent space.

nest.name: Nest
nest.description: A stationary enemy. Instead of attacking, it spreads boils.

likho.name: Likho
likho.description: A stationary enemy that blocks passages.

pack.name: Pack
pack.description: Several small enemies. Can move through vents.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: A nimble, fast enemy. The player’s combat strength is reduced by 1.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.description: An advanced form of the Restless. Can move through vents.

seeker.name: Seeker
seeker.description: Hunts the player with the lowest health. Can move through vents.

restless.name: Restless
restless.description: Infected human. The player’s combat strength is reduced by 1.

mother.name: Mother
mother.description: Boss. Attacks ignore defense. Health and attack increase by 1 for each player.

viy.name: Viy
viy.description: Boss. Health and attack increase by 1 for each player.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: Boss. Health and attack increase by 1 for each living monster in play.

leshy.name: Leshy
leshy.description: Boss. Flees from players and leaves 2 boils in its space before its turn.

boil.name: Boil
boil.description: A stationary gas bubble. It bursts and dies when it shares a space with a player.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.description: All map tiles are open simultaneously.

quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
quartermaster.description: There are 5 cards in the chest.

agile.name: Daredevil
agile.description: Dodge 3 attacks in one turn without taking damage.

cripple.name: Cripple
cripple.description: Have 3 or more Condition cards at once.

robot-owner.name: Robot Owner
robot-owner.description: Use and recharge a robot twice during the game.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.description: Roll 4 successes in a single roll.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Kill two enemies in one turn.

special.name: Special
special.description: Obtain a card from the Special Items deck without trading for it.

abscessive.name: Abscessive
abscessive.description: Pop more than 5 Abscesses at once.

exterminator.name: Exterminator
exterminator.description: Defeat a strong enemy alone in one turn.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: Buy a Supply item worth 10 or more credits.

cabin-noise.name: Cabin Noise
cabin-noise.description: As you pass a cabin, you hear a commotion inside.

o1.success: You open an empty cabin and find a bag hanging from a squeaky hook. Draw a Supply card.
o1.failure: The door flies open and an angry monster lunges at you. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You decide not to get involved in trouble.
o2.failure: You walk past, but danger is waiting ahead.

vending-machine.name: Vending Machine
vending-machine.description: As you wander through the ship, you find a vending machine with someone’s food still inside.

o1.success: You wrench your hand free with the food. Restore 2 health.
o1.failure: Your hand gets stuck in the machine. When you finally get free, you see a monster approaching. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

pile-of-things.name: Pile of Things
pile-of-things.description: You enter a room and see a pile of objects that might contain something useful.

o1.success: You find a suitable weapon. Draw an Item card.
o1.failure: Something moves among the objects. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.action: Leave the pile alone and leave the room.
o2.success: You get away from the strange pile in time.
o2.failure: A monster notices you before you can leave. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

monster-nest.name: Monster Lair
monster-nest.description: You have found a creature’s lair. There must be something interesting inside.

o1.success: After defeating the monster, draw 1 Supply card.
o1.failure: Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You enter the lair and leave with supplies without being noticed. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: The noise wakes a sleeping monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o3.success: Discard a Gas Cylinder. The blast destroys the lair; draw a Supply card.
o3.failure: Discard a Gas Cylinder, but the blast attracts a monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

corpse.name: Crew Member’s Corpse
corpse.description: Searching the ship, you spot a person. As you get closer, you realize it is a corpse.

o1.success: You put the family photo back and take an Old Cloak from the Special Items deck.
o1.failure: You cannot get away in time: the corpse reanimates. Draw a Restless card and fight it.

o2.action: Leave the corpse alone and search the room.
o2.success: You leave the body alone and find supplies. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: The corpse reanimates behind you. Draw a Restless card and fight it.

suitcases.name: Suitcases of the Dead
suitcases.description: You find a pile of suitcases that belonged to deceased crew members.

o1.success: You find a few credits in the suitcases. Gain 5 credits.
o1.failure: A monster has made its home inside. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You walk past, and it was the right choice: a monster runs by.
o2.failure: You disturb the monster after all. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

hatch-monster.name: Monster in the Hatch
hatch-monster.description: While searching for supplies, you slide open a hatch and see a monster hiding inside.

o1.action: Slip past it to the supplies.
o1.success: The monster is distracted by the noise. Draw 2 Supply cards.
o1.failure: The monster spots you. Take 3 damage and perform 1 fewer action next turn.

o2.action: Close the hatch and search elsewhere.
o2.success: You close the hatch and find a package nearby. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: As you leave, the noise attracts a monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

security-room.name: Security Room
security-room.description: You enter a security room. The alarm is still active.

o1.success: You grab the first thing you see. Draw an Item card.
o1.failure: The alarm attracts a monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You search the room undisturbed. Draw the top 3 Item cards, choose 1, and shuffle the rest back into the deck.
o2.failure: The alarm attracts a monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

exposed-wires.name: Exposed Wires
exposed-wires.description: The wiring in the corridor ahead is damaged. Bare wires touch the floor.

o1.success: You cross to the other end of the room.
o1.failure: You touch a wire and take 2 damage.

o2.action: Find the power source and shut it off.
o2.success: The power is off, and you pass safely.
o2.failure: You touch a wire and take 2 damage.

o3.success: You avoid the wires, but meet a monster on your way back. Draw a Monster card and fight it.
o3.failure: Draw a Monster card and fight it.

monster-pack.name: Pack Around the Corner
monster-pack.description: You hear growling and the footsteps of a group of monsters coming toward you from around the corner.

o1.success: You hide and the pack passes by.
o1.failure: One of the monsters spots you. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: Move to an adjacent sector.
o2.failure: You run into another enemy. Move to an adjacent sector, draw a Monster card, and fight it.

rope-hatch.name: Rope in the Hatch
rope-hatch.description: You notice a deep hatch at your feet. A rope tied to a post has been lowered into it.

o1.success: You pull up a bloodstained belt with a pouch. Draw a Supply card.
o1.failure: You decide it is not worth throwing out your back.

o2.success: A loud noise from the bottom of the hatch attracts a monster. Place a Monster card in any adjacent sector.
o2.failure: A loud noise from the bottom of the hatch attracts a monster. Place a Monster card in any adjacent sector.

o3.success: You walk past and leave the hatch alone.
o3.failure: You walk past and leave the hatch alone.

weapon-monster.name: Weapon in Its Mouth
weapon-monster.description: At the far end of the room, you see a monster with something like a weapon sticking out of its mouth.

o1.success: You wrench out the weapon and smash the monster’s head. Draw a Weapon card.
o1.failure: The monster attacks. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You decide not to risk it and stay unnoticed.
o2.failure: You attract the monster’s attention. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

repair-cleaner.name: Broken Cleaning Robot
repair-cleaner.description: A cleaning robot lies on its side in the corner, sparking and crackling.

o1.success: There is a useful find in its waste tank. Draw a Supply card.
o1.failure: You decide not to waste parts on this pile of scrap.

o2.success: This mess is the least of your problems.
o2.failure: This mess is the least of your problems.

countdown-trap.name: Countdown
countdown-trap.description: A mechanical voice reaches you: “10,” “9,” “8.” It looks like you triggered a trap.

o1.success: You pull out a wire. Kill one monster in your sector or an adjacent sector, ignoring loot.
o1.failure: You take 4 damage.

o2.success: You leap out of the room. Move 1 sector.
o2.failure: The blast knocks you down. Take 4 damage and take one fewer action on your next turn.

scientist-report.name: Scientific Report
scientist-report.description: You see a disfigured body in a white coat, holding a folder of papers.

o1.success: This is Dr. Neumyvakin’s report. Keep this card; get +1 Science.
o1.failure: The numbers and charts mean nothing to you. Leave the papers.

monster-corpse.name: Monster’s Body
monster-corpse.description: A horrible stench hangs in the air around the dismembered monster.

o1.success: You find a clue to its weak points. Keep this card; get +1 Combat Strength.
o1.failure: The disgusting sight makes you leave.

rubble.name: Rubble
rubble.description: You walk calmly through the ship and come across rubble blocking the way.

o1.success: The way is clear, and a heavy bag lies beneath the debris. Draw an Item card.
o1.failure: The debris collapses on you. Take 3 damage.

o2.success: You go around the rubble but run into a Restless. Draw a Restless card and fight it.
o2.failure: The route leads straight to a monster. Draw a Restless card and fight it.

two-crates.name: Two Crates
two-crates.description: You enter a cabin and see two crates: one very large and the other small.

o1.success: There is a droid inside. Take a Robot from the Item deck.
o1.failure: The crate falls on you. Take 2 damage.

o2.action: Don’t overestimate yourself; take the small crate.
o2.success: You carry the crate somewhere safe. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: You drop the crate but find 2 credits nearby.

huge-crate.name: Huge Crate
huge-crate.description: You enter a cabin and see a very large crate.

o1.success: You drag the crate and find a weapon. Draw a Weapon card.
o1.failure: The crate falls on you. Take 2 damage.

o2.action: Send the droid for the crate.
o2.success: Discard a Robot card. Take a Weapon and draw 1 Supply card.
o2.failure: The droid breaks, and you leave the crate.

toolbox.name: Tools and Parts
toolbox.description: You found a box of tools and parts. What can you do with it?

o1.success: You make a strange but effective weapon. Take a Swiss Army Knife from the Special Items deck.
o1.failure: You fail to make anything.

o2.success: The pile of metal gives a cheerful beep. Take the DRG-4U robot from the Special Items deck.
o2.failure: You fail to make anything.

o3.success: The armor is not fashionable, but it works. Draw an Item card.

exoskeleton-terminal.name: Cargo Terminal
exoskeleton-terminal.description: You see a terminal for cargo loaders’ special equipment on the wall. Its door is damaged.

o1.success: Behind it is a heavy-load suit. Take the Exoskeleton from the Special Items deck.
o1.failure: The door is jammed shut.

contraband-cache.name: Smugglers’ Stash
contraband-cache.description: Behind the electrical panel door is a note with the location of a stash beneath the navigation terminal.

o1.success: There is a sealed box beneath it. Draw an Item card.
o1.failure: You hit the terminal. Take 1 damage.

o2.success: You decide the stash must be a trap and leave.
o2.failure: You decide the stash must be a trap and leave.

falling-monster.name: Falling Monster
falling-monster.description: A mangled body drops from the ceiling and reaches for your throat with its teeth.

o1.success: You smash the monster’s head with the first thing at hand. Discard a Weapon card.
o1.failure: You fall onto a spike. Take 3 damage.

collapsed-panel.name: Beeping Under the Panel
collapsed-panel.description: You hear a muffled beep beneath a collapsed ceiling panel.

o1.action: Find the source of the sound.
o1.success: There is a robot under the debris. Take a Robot from the Item deck.
o1.failure: You are injured while clearing the rubble. Take 1 damage.

o2.success: You leave and move to an adjacent sector.
o2.failure: You leave and move to an adjacent sector.

blood-trail.name: Bloody Tracks
blood-trail.description: You notice bloody tracks, but they clearly do not belong to a human.

o1.success: The tracks lead to a dead human and monster. Draw a Weapon card.
o1.failure: You get lost and run into a monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: A monster attacks from behind. Take 3 damage.
o2.failure: A monster attacks from behind. Take 3 damage.

ship-map.name: Unknown Map
ship-map.description: You found a ship map showing an unfamiliar passage.

o1.success: You find the passage and a droid. Take a Robot from the Item deck.
o1.failure: You cannot find your way out of the passage. Take one fewer action next turn.

o2.success: Leave the map and reveal any unexplored map tile.
o2.failure: Leave the map and reveal any unexplored map tile.

cache-symbols.name: Stash Symbols
cache-symbols.description: You find markings on the wall pointing to a supply stash.

o1.success: You find the stash. Draw the top 3 Supply cards, choose 1, and shuffle the others back.
o1.failure: You cannot decipher the symbols and waste time.

scientist-case.name: Scientist’s Briefcase
scientist-case.description: You find a dead scientist clutching a metal briefcase to their chest.

o1.success: Inside is a healing serum. Restore all health.
o1.failure: There are only incomprehensible notes from the scientist.

o2.action: Leave the body undisturbed and search elsewhere.
o2.success: There is a useful item on the nearby shelves. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: There is a useful item on the nearby shelves. Draw a Supply card.

inventory-notes.name: Inventory Notes
inventory-notes.description: You stumble over a box of charred papers: records of the latest deliveries.

o1.action: Try to make sense of the notes.
o1.success: A route map leads to an equipment storeroom. Draw 2 Item cards.
o1.failure: The notes are too damaged to be useful.

nest-room.name: Monster Nest
nest-room.description: You enter a room and see that monsters have made a nest there.

o1.success: If you have a flamethrower, the nest is destroyed.
o1.failure: You have no flamethrower, or you decide not to spend it.

o2.success: You find ingredients for explosives.
o2.failure: Your search attracts the monster guarding the nest. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o3.success: You weld the door shut, keeping the monsters from reaching you.
o3.failure: The welding noise attracts a monster. Draw a Monster card, place it in your sector, and move to an adjacent sector.

needle-box.name: Box of Needles
needle-box.description: A strange box with needles sticking out lies on the floor.

o1.success: It is a portable vaccine injector. Restore 3 health and gain +1 Defense for the next round.
o1.failure: The terminology is incomprehensible, so you leave the box.

o2.success: You decide not to touch the strange object.
o2.failure: You decide not to touch the strange object.

bloody-suitcase.name: Suitcase with a Bloody Message
bloody-suitcase.description: There is a suitcase in front of you with a severed arm. Something is written on it in blood.

o1.success: You decipher a code in the message. Draw a Supply card.
o1.failure: The writing turns out to be a waste of time.

o2.success: You pick the lock and find personal belongings. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: The lock will not open, so you leave the suitcase.

broken-drone.name: Broken Droid
broken-drone.description: You enter a room looking for something useful and see a broken droid.

o1.success: The droid gets back on its feet. Take a Robot from the Item deck.
o1.failure: An electric shock stuns you. Take one fewer action next turn.

o2.success: You walk past, but do not leave empty-handed. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: You walk past, but do not leave empty-handed. Draw a Supply card.

radio-transmitter.name: Radio Transmitter
radio-transmitter.description: You find a radio transmitter and decide to send a distress signal.

o1.success: The signal is received. Each crew member draws a Supply card.
o1.failure: The transmitter’s static attracts a monster. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: Technology repair is not your strength, so you move on.
o2.failure: Technology repair is not your strength, so you move on.

lights-out.name: Lights Out
lights-out.description: You discover that the lights are out in some rooms.

o1.action: Repair the lights in the nearest room.
o1.success: The lights come on. Reveal the nearest unexplored map tile.
o1.failure: You take 3 damage from the wiring.

ventilation-failure.name: Faulty Ventilation
ventilation-failure.description: The ventilation system starts failing in the room.

o1.success: Behind the grate you find a body and a heavy bag. Draw a Supply card.
o1.failure: A monster crawls out of the vent. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You get out in time. Take 2 damage.
o2.failure: You get out in time. Take 2 damage.

gas-pipe.name: Burst Pipe
gas-pipe.description: You smell something strange and realize you are surrounded by gas.

o1.success: You repair the pipe. Restore 2 health.
o1.failure: You inhale gas. Take 2 damage and take one fewer action next turn.

vent-monster.name: Growling in the Vent
vent-monster.description: You hear growling from the air duct.

o1.success: The airflow pulls the monster back.
o1.failure: Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: You secure the room. Draw an Item card.
o2.failure: The monster breaks free. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o3.success: Discard the Gas Canister and draw 2 Supply cards.
o3.failure: Discard the Gas Canister and draw 2 Supply cards.

security-console.name: Security Console
security-console.description: The security control console seems to have no power, but is undamaged.

o1.success: The security system is on. Kill any non-boss monster aboard the ship.
o1.failure: The console cannot be repaired.

o2.action: Take the console apart for parts.
o2.success: The parts will be useful. Ready all your Robots.
o2.failure: The junk turns out to be useless.

cigarette-machine.name: Cigarette Vending Machine
cigarette-machine.description: The light is still on in the cigarette machine in front of you.

o1.success: You find the change. Gain 10 credits.
o1.failure: The machine is well protected from clever people like you.

o2.success: The machine pays you off with a pack of cigarettes. Restore 2 health and ready your Robots.
o2.failure: You leave the machine alone.

pack-sighting.name: Pack
pack-sighting.description: You run into a pack. You should flee, but you notice something valuable.

o1.success: You decide not to take the risk and run.
o1.failure: The pack spots you. Draw a Pack card and fight it.

o2.success: You remain unnoticed and draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: The pack chases you. Draw a Pack card and fight it.

gas-cabin.name: Green Gas
gas-cabin.description: You pass a cabin filled with a strange green gas.

o1.success: You grab an item and get out. Draw an Item card.
o1.failure: You run into an Abscess. Take one fewer action next turn.

o2.success: You decide not to enter the cabin.
o2.failure: You decide not to enter the cabin.

hatch-scrape.name: Scraping Under the Hatch
hatch-scrape.description: It sounds like something is scraping inside the maintenance hatch beneath your feet.

o1.success: You pile crates over the hatch.
o1.failure: The hatch opens. Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: Draw a Monster card and fight it. After winning, draw an additional Item card.
o2.failure: Draw a Monster card and fight it.

oxygen-alarm.name: Oxygen Depletion
oxygen-alarm.description: The system reports a power overload and that oxygen is being pumped out.

o1.success: You wait until oxygen supply resumes.
o1.failure: You lose consciousness and take 2 damage; take one fewer action next turn.

o2.action: Run out before the doors seal.
o2.success: You rush into an adjacent sector.
o2.failure: You do not make it in time. Take 2 damage and take one fewer action next turn.

survivor-scream.name: Cry for Help
survivor-scream.description: You hear a scream. It sounds like another survivor.

o1.success: There is a monster standing over a guard’s body. Draw a Monster card and fight it.
o1.failure: There are useful supplies by the body. Draw a Supply card.

o2.success: Survival leaves no room for morality.
o2.failure: Survival leaves no room for morality.

child-cry.name: Child’s Cry
child-cry.description: You hear a child crying. How could there be a child here?

o1.action: Find the source as quickly as possible.
o1.success: It is a monster growling. Draw a Monster card and fight it.
o1.failure: You cannot find the source. Place a monster in any adjacent sector.

o2.success: You refuse to let your imagination take over and continue on.
o2.failure: You refuse to let your imagination take over and continue on.

female-whisper.name: Whisper
female-whisper.description: You hear a woman whispering, but cannot make out any words.

o1.action: Resist; it is only your imagination.
o1.success: You calm down: it is only the hum of the lights.
o1.failure: Other voices join the whisper. Place a monster in every adjacent sector.

o2.success: It is a plea for help. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: It is a plea for help. Draw a Supply card.

alcohol-crate.name: Crate of Alcohol
alcohol-crate.description: You find the last thing you expected: a crate of alcohol.

o1.success: You keep a clear head.
o1.failure: You keep a clear head.

o2.success: Restore 3 health and take one extra action next turn.
o2.failure: Take one fewer action next turn.

o3.success: Restore all health, gain an extra action, and take no damage from monsters until the end of next round.
o3.failure: You lose control and take one fewer action next turn.

supply-terminal.name: Supply Terminal
supply-terminal.description: The supply terminal is flashing brightly. It seems to have malfunctioned.

o1.success: Draw 5 Supply cards; you may buy 2 Items at a 2-credit discount, and shuffle the rest back.
o1.failure: The terminal is broken, but you can still inspect it.

o2.success: Sell any number of your Items at full value.
o2.failure: Sell any number of your Items at full value.

o3.success: You do not stop and keep moving.
o3.failure: You do not stop and keep moving.

trade-bot.name: Trade Bot
trade-bot.description: A trade bot has fallen on its side. It looks battered but still operational.

o1.success: Draw 5 Supply cards; you may buy them and sell Items at full value.
o1.failure: The damage is too severe. The bot does not work.

o2.action: Break into the bot’s cargo bay.
o2.success: The corporation protects its bots well, and you get nothing.
o2.failure: The corporation protects its bots well, and you get nothing.

lockers.name: Personal Lockers
lockers.description: A blood trail leads to the personal lockers of the local workers.

o1.success: There are bloodstained clothes in one locker. Draw a Clothing card.
o1.failure: There are bloodstained clothes in one locker. Draw a Clothing card.

o2.success: You decide not to tempt fate and leave.
o2.failure: You decide not to tempt fate and leave.

body-pile.name: Seven Bags
body-pile.description: Seven bags containing the bodies of dead crew members are piled in the corner.

o1.success: There are personal belongings under the bags. Draw a Clothing card and a Restless card, and fight it.
o1.failure: Draw a Restless card and fight it.

o2.success: You are content that the dead are not following you.
o2.failure: You are content that the dead are not following you.

junk-medical.name: Medical Junk
junk-medical.description: A heap of rubble and junk catches your attention.

o1.success: There is an implant left in a medical case. Take an Implant from the Item deck.
o1.failure: There is an implant left in a medical case. Take an Implant from the Item deck.

o2.action: Search the junk for something useful.
o2.success: You find an Item card.
o2.failure: You cut yourself on a rusty beam. Take 1 damage.

o3.action: Make your way to the far crates.
o3.success: There is nothing useful in the crates. Gain 1 credit.
o3.failure: You give up after an unsuccessful attempt.

junk-credits.name: Waist Pouch
junk-credits.description: Among the rubble, junk, and crates, you notice someone’s belt.

o1.success: There are 5 credits in the pouch.
o1.failure: There are 5 credits in the pouch.

o2.action: Search the junk for something useful.
o2.success: There is an Item card in the far crate.
o2.failure: The junk starts to slide, so you retreat.

junk-guitar.name: Heap of Junk
junk-guitar.description: The stench from the pile of rubble drives even the monsters away.

o1.success: You find an almost intact guitar and leave.
o1.failure: You find an almost intact guitar and leave.

o2.action: Make your way to the far crates.
o2.success: A stash is tied to the pile. Gain 10 credits.
o2.failure: The junk is too slippery, and you decide not to climb over it.

shelf-equipment.name: Top Shelf
shelf-equipment.description: You see some equipment on the top shelf of a rack in the corner.

o1.success: You take the loot. Draw an Item card.
o1.failure: The shelves give way. Take 2 damage.

o2.success: You find something useful. Draw a Supply card.
o2.failure: You find nothing useful.

falling-beam.name: Falling Beam
falling-beam.description: A massive metal beam falls on you and pins you to the floor.

o1.action: Get out from under the rubble.
o1.success: You take 1 damage.
o1.failure: Take 3 damage and discard an Armor card.

meteor-stream.name: Meteor Stream
meteor-stream.description: You feel a series of jolts: the ship has entered a meteor stream.

o1.success: Each player rolls a die and takes damage equal to the result.
o1.failure: Each player rolls a die and takes damage equal to the result.

fire.name: Fire
fire.description: Metal groans and pops as fire spreads through the ventilation system.

o1.success: Roll a die and take damage equal to the result.
o1.failure: Roll a die and take damage equal to the result.

o2.action: Try to put out the fire.
o2.success: Take 3 damage.
o2.failure: Take 3 damage.

monster-horde.name: Horde
monster-horde.description: A loud explosion has scattered a monster nest. Fast footsteps are getting louder.

o1.success: Draw a Monster card and fight it.
o1.failure: Draw a Monster card and fight it.

o2.success: Take 2 damage.
o2.failure: Take 2 damage.

asteroid-alert.name: Asteroid Alert
asteroid-alert.description: The system announces: “Asteroid detected. All ship compartments are being sealed.”

o1.action: Get out of the corridor quickly.
o1.success: Each player in a corridor rolls a die and takes that much damage. Close all corridors and move creatures in them to adjacent sectors.
o1.failure: Each player in a corridor rolls a die and takes that much damage. Close all corridors and move creatures in them to adjacent sectors.

horde-carry.name: Footsteps All Around
horde-carry.description: Fast footsteps come from every direction. There is no doubt: a horde of monsters is rushing this way.

o1.success: Discard all cards from your backpack or take 2 damage for each card you keep.
o1.failure: Discard all cards from your backpack or take 2 damage for each card you keep.

quest-01.name: Awakening
quest-01.description: Find the other crew members and learn what happened.

quest-02.name: Survival Law
quest-02.description: After making it through the darkness and the horror hidden within, you realize that you will find no one here. At least, no one alive. Blood and disorder surround you, the ship’s systems do not work, and metal grinds without end. To survive, you must not panic. You will not last long if you simply hide and wait for help. The main task now is to bring the ship back to life. But first, you should ensure your own safety.

quest-03.name: The Ship Awakens
quest-03.description: According to the terminal, most of the electronics and communications systems are not working. That means the autopilot is down, as are the ship’s engines. Horrified at the prospect of being trapped here with these monsters, you decide to wake the ship so you can get home. The terminal has diagnosed multiple failures in the reactor room.

quest-04.name: Infected
quest-04.description: The ship’s power has been restored. At last, you can start the engines and set a course home. Less than a minute later, you feel a severe bout of arrhythmia. The weakness you felt can no longer be blamed on cryosleep. There is now one more problem on the path to safety, as if the horrors around you were not enough.

quest-05.name: Antidote
quest-05.description: The blood samples have been collected and the analysis is complete. You are infected, and dangerous. You cannot return to Earth while there is a risk of spreading this disease. The only way out is to go to the laboratory and make a cure. But you must act quickly: it is unclear how soon the illness will fully emerge or how it will progress.

quest-06.name: Rescue
quest-06.description: Only a few corridors separate you from the ship’s main computer. You only need to get there and turn on power to the engines. Then you can direct the ship home!

quest-07.name: Plan B
quest-07.description: Turning on the power was not enough. The sensors show that the engines have been damaged from outside. You cannot handle this on your own. There is only one right decision: leave the ship and all the creatures behind, and escape in the capsules. Home is close; all you need to do is get into a capsule and set off.

quest-08.name: Search
quest-08.description: “Does anything on this ship still work?” you shout, kicking the broken escape pod. Exhausted by the troubles piling up, you set out to find the missing part. In the storage bay, you find the place buried under useful and useless things in total chaos. It will be very difficult to find what you need.

quest-09.name: Captain
quest-09.description: You have one more problem to solve if you do not want to drift in a capsule through open space: entering the coordinates of the nearest border base. It seems you will have to visit the ship’s captain in Flight Control…

quest-10.name: Final Preparations
quest-10.description: After finding the missing parts, you return to the escape pods. There is almost nothing left to do: install the part and head home.

quest-11.name: Home
quest-11.description: At last everything is in order. You are eager to leave this cursed place and never return. As you head for the launch panel, you hear a roar that shakes the walls. What in the world is that creature!?

quest-12.name: Epilogue
quest-12.description: Leaning back in your chair, you slowly exhale. Thoughts of the friends and colleagues you lost fill your mind, but you have no desire to look back. One last task remains: warn Earth about what happened.

quest-13.name: Time for a Boomstick
quest-13.description: Walking around the ship unarmed is suicide. You urgently need something for protection, preferably a firearm. Right! The ship has an armory with all the security equipment. Perhaps something remains that can blow these monsters apart.

quest-14.name: Annihilation
quest-14.description: So many deaths… Many of them were your friends. Rage fills you. It is time to take revenge on these creatures.

quest-15.name: Survival Guide
quest-15.description: Now that you have a weapon, it is time to find supplies. Perhaps there is something useful in the dining hall. It is worth checking.

quest-16.name: Heart of the Swarm
quest-16.description: It seems you have stirred up a hornet’s nest. The monsters appear to be changing strategy. You see several creatures run past, ignoring you.

quest-17.name: Plague Doctor
quest-17.description: It is time to learn more about the infection that has ravaged the crew’s bodies. Perhaps it can still be stopped…
